cues.en: In May 2005,
a group of elder men of the Bamigo family of smiths in Burkina Faso
cues.zh: 布基纳法索巴米戈铁匠家族的一群长老

cues.en: gathered to smelt iron for the first time in over sixty years.
cues.zh: 聚在一起，进行六十多年来的第一次冶铁。

cues.en: These were men who had seen the process when they were young, and a few of the oldest had actually done it themselves.
cues.zh: 这些人在年轻时见过这一过程，其中几位最年长的还曾亲手做过。

cues.en: They were supported and organized by a much younger member of the family, Jacob Bamago,
cues.zh: 他们得到了家族中年轻得多的成员雅各布·巴马戈的支持和组织，

cues.en: who filmed this with the help of his nephew, Abdullah.
cues.zh: 雅各布在侄子阿卜杜拉的帮助下拍摄了这段影像。

cues.en: The smelting took place in the village of Dablo in Northern Burkina Faso,
cues.zh: 冶铁在布基纳法索北部的达布洛村进行，

cues.en: North Of Kaya and at the edge of the Sahel.
cues.zh: 位于卡亚以北、萨赫勒边缘。

cues.en: Burkina Faso is a small landlocked country North of Ghana and between Mali to the Northwest and Niger to the Northeast.
cues.zh: 布基纳法索是一个内陆小国，位于加纳以北，西北接马里，东北邻尼日尔。

cues.en: Africans have been making iron for well over two thousand years.
cues.zh: 非洲人冶铁已有两千多年历史。

cues.en: The manufacture of high quality carbon steel allowed Africans to produce effective weapons for warfare and efficient tools for farming.
cues.zh: 高质量碳钢的制造使非洲人能够生产有效的战争武器和高效的农具。

cues.en: Without iron technology,
cues.zh: 没有铁技术，

cues.en: the spread of agriculture and of developed civilizations across Africa would not have been possible.
cues.zh: 农业和发达文明在非洲的传播就不可能实现。

cues.en: By the beginning of the twentieth century, when the first French colonials arrived in Burkina Faso,
cues.zh: 到二十世纪初，首批法国殖民者抵达布基纳法索时，

cues.en: then called Upper Volta,
cues.zh: 当时该地被称为上沃尔特，

cues.en: they found a thriving iron smelting industry
cues.zh: 他们发现了一个蓬勃发展的冶铁业，

cues.en: by which tons of high quality metal were produced every year. Within
cues.zh: 每年生产数吨高质量金属。在

cues.en: a few decades,
cues.zh: 几十年内，

cues.en: the French began to use trucks and automobiles
cues.zh: 法国人开始在他们强迫臣民修建的道路上

cues.en: on the roads they forced their subjects to construct.
cues.zh: 使用卡车和汽车。

cues.en: When the first French auto smashed at a high rate of speed into a huge mahogany tree by the side of the road,
cues.zh: 当第一辆法国汽车高速撞上路旁一棵巨大的桃花心木树时，

cues.en: the smelting industry died for sniffs could find a cheap and plentiful source of good metal.
cues.zh: 冶炼工业消亡了，因为人们能找到廉价且充足的优质金属来源。

cues.en: Forging continued,
cues.zh: 锻造还在继续，

cues.en: but smelting ended.
cues.zh: 但冶炼终结了。

cues.en: Since the nineteen sixties, merchants have imported large quantities of inexpensive mass produced iron from China and Japan, and no iron has been smelted from raw ore anywhere in Africa for almost fifty years.
cues.zh: 自20世纪60年代以来，商人们从中国和日本进口了大量廉价的大规模生产铁，非洲各地已有近五十年没有从原矿石中冶炼过铁了。

cues.en: The technology documented on this film is the first smelting of iron from ore in Burkina Faso since the nineteen sixties.
cues.zh: 这部影片记录的技术，是布基纳法索自20世纪60年代以来首次从矿石中冶炼铁。

cues.en: Very special hardwood with high caloric content is selected.
cues.zh: 人们会挑选热量含量很高的特殊硬木。

cues.en: Fuel is as important to the smelting process as the iron itself.
cues.zh: 燃料对冶炼过程的重要性不亚于铁本身。

cues.en: Special charcoal is used that has a very high BTU content.
cues.zh: 使用的是热量含量极高的特殊木炭。

cues.en: Jacques Soba Bamagot, one of the senior Smith elders,
cues.zh: Jacques Soba Bamagot是铁匠长老之一，

cues.en: has specialized in charcoal burning all of his life. He
cues.zh: 他一生都专门从事烧炭。他

cues.en: and his younger helpers go into the wilderness some distance from Dablo to find suitable hardwood trees that will produce the best charcoal.
cues.zh: 和年轻的帮手们会深入远离Dablo的荒野，寻找能烧出最好木炭的合适硬木树。

cues.en: These are cut, stacked, and burned.
cues.zh: 这些树被砍下、堆叠并焚烧。

cues.en: Jacques Sobe is showing us how he lights the charcoal using a flint and steel instead of white man's matches.
cues.zh: Jacques Sobe正在向我们展示他如何用火石和钢片取火点燃木炭，而不是用白人的火柴。

cues.en: The wind has come up and is causing problems
cues.zh: 起风了，带来了麻烦，

cues.en: because it will make the wood burn unevenly.
cues.zh: 因为这会让木柴燃烧不均匀。

cues.en: The bomigos stack leafy branches upwind to block the wind.
cues.zh: bomigos在上风处堆起带叶的树枝来挡风。

cues.en: Jacob does not have a windscreen for his microphone,
cues.zh: Jacob没有给麦克风装防风罩，

cues.en: so there's a lot of wind noise on the video.
cues.zh: 所以视频里有很多风噪。

cues.en: They use a fork called a rayaka to push the wood back into the fire, so it will all burn nicely.
cues.zh: 他们用一把叫rayaka的叉子把木柴推回火里，好让所有木柴都能充分燃烧。

cues.en: As soon as all of the wood is lighted, the men begin to cover or smother the wood with sand,
cues.zh: 木柴一点着，这些人就开始用沙子覆盖或闷住木柴，

cues.en: so that the heat will turn the wood into charcoal without consuming it.
cues.zh: 这样热量就能把木柴变成木炭，而不会把它烧掉。

cues.en: By smothering the wood as it burns, oxygen is excluded.
cues.zh: 通过在木柴燃烧时将其闷住，氧气被隔绝在外。

cues.en: Molecular water is driven from the wood reducing it to charcoal without oxidizing it and turning it to useless ash.
cues.zh: 木柴中的分子水被驱出，使其还原为木炭，而不会被氧化成无用的灰烬。

cues.en: Four days later, they returned to the pile and removed the sand covering,
cues.zh: 四天后，他们回到柴堆，拨开覆盖的沙子，

cues.en: revealing the high quality hardwood charcoal they need for a successful smelting.
cues.zh: 露出成功冶炼所需的高品质硬木木炭。

cues.en: The
cues.zh: 用来拨开木炭的

cues.en: tool that is used to uncover the charcoal is called sandore.
cues.zh: 工具叫作sandore。

cues.en: They have uncovered it all so they can take it home.
cues.zh: 他们把木炭全部拨出来了，好带回家。

cues.en: They're
cues.zh: 他们

cues.en: loading it into baskets to carry back home.
cues.zh: 正把木炭装进篮子，准备运回家。

cues.en: They carry the charcoal back to Dabla in baskets.
cues.zh: 他们用篮子把木炭运回Dabla。

cues.en: All the charcoal is dumped at the workplace.
cues.zh: 所有木炭都卸在工作场地。

cues.en: People greet them with welcome. You've done a good job.
cues.zh: 人们迎接他们，说：干得好。

cues.en: This is the group of Bamigo elders from the village of Dablo, West of Kaya, who made the smelting possible.
cues.zh: 这群来自Kaya以西Dablo村的Bamigo长者，促成了这次冶炼。

cues.en: Iron is made of iron ore. The elders begin the process by locating a source of ore. In this case, a pit they and their ancestors have used decades earlier.
cues.zh: 铁是从铁矿石中炼出来的。长者们先找到矿石来源，开始整个流程。这次用的是他们和祖先几十年前用过的矿坑。

cues.en: The ore is excavated by hand and baskets and is sorted by quality, removing as much clay as possible.
cues.zh: 矿石用手和篮子挖出，并按品质分选，尽量去除黏土。

cues.en: It is then carried back to the village of Dablo, where the chunks of ore are broken open, the nuggets of pure iron are removed and as much clay and impurities as possible are discarded.
cues.zh: 然后运回Dablo村，把矿石块敲开，取出纯铁块，尽量丢弃黏土和杂质。

cues.en: Two full baskets of high quality ore are needed for one kiln.
cues.zh: 烧一个窑需要两满筐高质量的矿石。

cues.en: Here Rasinghe Bamago and the other elders are discussing how and where they will mine the ore.
cues.zh: 在这里，拉辛格·巴马戈（Rasinghe Bamago）和其他长老正在讨论如何以及在哪里开采矿石。

cues.en: Here, Jacquesoba and another elder are getting ready to mine the ore from a shallow pit not far from Dablo.
cues.zh: 在这里，雅克索巴（Jacquesoba）和另一位长老正准备从达布洛附近的一个浅坑里开采矿石。

cues.en: Among the most honored and respected scholars of West African archaeology
cues.zh: 在西非考古学界备受尊崇的学者中，

cues.en: is professor Jean Baptiste Kantiga of the University of Ouagadougou.
cues.zh: 有一位是瓦加杜古大学的让·巴蒂斯特·坎蒂加（Jean Baptiste Kantiga）教授。

cues.en: Professor Kantiga has published extensively on both iron and gold mining and technology,
cues.zh: 坎蒂加教授在铁矿、金矿开采及其技术方面发表了大量著作，

cues.en: And is perhaps in part motivated in his interest in iron by the fact that he comes from one of the two very large smith clans in the Mosi area. The other being the Bamigo family.
cues.zh: 他对铁感兴趣，部分原因可能是他出身于莫西地区两个极大的铁匠家族之一，另一个则是巴马戈家族。

cues.en: Professor Kantaga has discovered an archaeological site associated with smelting that dates to 365
cues.zh: 坎塔加教授发现了一个与冶炼相关的考古遗址，其历史可追溯至公元前365年

cues.en: to two hundred and twenty BC,
cues.zh: 到公元前220年，

cues.en: which indicates that smelting developed independently
cues.zh: 这表明冶炼技术在

cues.en: in Burkina Faso.
cues.zh: 布基纳法索是独立发展的。

cues.en: Although Burkina is covered with red iron rich soil, it is not always easy to locate good sources of iron ore.
cues.zh: 尽管布基纳法索到处都是富含铁的红土，但要找到优质的铁矿源并非易事。

cues.en: In some areas, it is said that after a rain, you can see smoke rising from iron deposits.
cues.zh: 在某些地区，据说雨后可以看到铁矿藏升起青烟。

cues.en: Other people, including the Sennifo and Bois, use a metal rod to prospect for iron ore.
cues.zh: 其他人，包括森尼福人和博伊斯人，会用金属棒来勘探铁矿。

cues.en: In Mosi country, iron ore is usually mined in pits or shallow mines that may have connecting galleries.
cues.zh: 在莫西地区，铁矿通常在矿坑或可能有相连廊道的浅矿中开采。

cues.en: The miners from several villages make use of common ore pits.
cues.zh: 来自几个村庄的矿工共同使用公共矿坑。

cues.en: Smiths are readily able to distinguish ores that will yield high quality steel to be used in weapons,
cues.zh: 铁匠们很容易分辨出哪些矿石能炼出用于制造武器的高质量钢，

cues.en: as distinct from low quality or to be used only for hose.
cues.zh: 哪些是低质量的，或者只能用来做软管。

cues.en: Three types of ore are available in Burkina.
cues.zh: 布基纳法索有三种矿石可用。

cues.en: The best is magnetite
cues.zh: 最好的是磁铁矿，

cues.en: f e three zero four,
cues.zh: Fe₃O₄，

cues.en: which is about 43 to 70% iron.
cues.zh: 含铁量约为43%到70%。

cues.en: This is difficult to find in much of Burkina.
cues.zh: 这在布基纳法索大部分地区很难找到。

cues.en: The second grade is red hematite,
cues.zh: 第二等级是红色赤铁矿，

cues.en: f e two zero three, which is about 40 to 65% iron.
cues.zh: Fe₂O₃，含铁量约为40%到65%。

cues.en: The least useful is brown hematite or limonite,
cues.zh: 最不实用的是褐色赤铁矿或褐铁矿，

cues.en: f e two zero three NH two two o, which is 40 to 60% iron.
cues.zh: Fe₂O₃·nH₂O，含铁量为40%到60%。

cues.en: This is easy to find all across Burkina.
cues.zh: 这种矿石在布基纳法索各地都很容易找到。

cues.en: Two types of furnaces are used in Burkina.
cues.zh: 布基纳法索使用两种类型的炉子。

cues.en: In the center and north are tall furnaces that use bellows to force air into the fire.
cues.zh: 在中部和北部，使用的是高炉，用风箱把空气压入火中。

cues.en: Some of these among the once reached a height of one and a half to six meters.
cues.zh: 其中一些炉子曾经达到一米半到六米的高度。

cues.en: This is the type used by the Bamagos.
cues.zh: 这是巴马戈人使用的类型。

cues.en: Another type, partially sunk into the ground and much smaller, produces a very small amount of iron.
cues.zh: 另一种类型部分下沉入地下，体积小得多，产铁量非常少。

cues.en: This is good quality magnetite,
cues.zh: 这是优质磁铁矿，

cues.en: rich in iron.
cues.zh: 富含铁。

cues.en: The elders are cleaning and sorting the ore from the surrounding clay.
cues.zh: 长者们正在清理和分拣矿石，去除周围的黏土。

cues.en: The kernels of good ore are called zosbinga
cues.zh: 优质矿石的颗粒被称为zosbinga，

cues.en: or hyena terms.
cues.zh: 或称鬣狗籽。

cues.en: They've cleaned the two full baskets they need for each of the two furnaces they are building.
cues.zh: 他们已经清理好了两个满篮子，这是他们正在建造的两座炉子各自所需的量。

cues.en: This is the way they will carry it back to the village.
cues.zh: 他们就是这样把矿石运回村庄的。

cues.en: This is the ore ready for the furnace.
cues.zh: 这就是准备入炉的矿石。

cues.en: The darker the ore, the higher the iron content.
cues.zh: 矿石颜色越深，含铁量越高。

cues.en: The second important mineral that is needed is an alkaline deposit that is also close to the town. This
cues.zh: 所需的第二种重要矿物是一种碱性沉积物，也离镇子很近。这种

cues.en: material is a stony material that when mixed with the ore and the smelting, allows the iron to melt at a much lower temperature
cues.zh: 材料是一种石质材料，与矿石混合并在冶炼过程中，能让铁在低得多的温度下熔化，

cues.en: and to flow together, separating from the slag or impurities.
cues.zh: 并汇聚流动，与矿渣或杂质分离。

cues.en: This flux is also mined near the town in Kerri De Dablo in baskets.
cues.zh: 这种助熔剂也在克里德达布洛镇附近用篮子开采。

cues.en: The stones that are gathered and mixed with the ore to make it flow easily are called O stones.
cues.zh: 收集并与矿石混合以便于其熔化的石头被称为 O 石。

cues.en: This is the flux ready to be mixed with iron ore and placed in the furnace.
cues.zh: 这就是准备与铁矿石混合并放入炉中的助熔剂。

cues.en: The furnace and tubes are made of clay, which itself is fireproof and durable.
cues.zh: 炉子和管子是用粘土制成的，粘土本身具有耐火和耐用的特性。

cues.en: Not just any clay will do.
cues.zh: 并非随便什么粘土都可以。

cues.en: The Bomigo Smiths use clay from termite mounds,
cues.zh: 博米戈铁匠使用白蚁丘的粘土，

cues.en: which is especially useful because it is free of stones and other impurities.
cues.zh: 这种粘土特别有用，因为它不含石头和其他杂质。

cues.en: The termites simply are not strong enough to incorporate stones in their structures.
cues.zh: 白蚁的力量根本不足以把石头放进它们的建筑里。

cues.en: Those who have studied African art know that the Igbo in Nigeria and many other peoples across Africa
cues.zh: 研究过非洲艺术的人都知道，尼日利亚的伊博族以及非洲各地的许多其他民族

cues.en: believe that clay from termite mounds is sacred because it comes from deep in the sacred earth.
cues.zh: 认为白蚁丘的粘土是神圣的，因为它来自神圣大地的深处。

cues.en: If you look closely at the clay in the basket, you can see the tunnels the termites have left.
cues.zh: 如果你仔细看篮子里的粘土，你能看到白蚁留下的隧道。

cues.en: The elders break up the mounds and carry the pieces back to Dablo,
cues.zh: 长老们砸碎土丘，把碎片运回达布洛，

cues.en: where they pound the chunks into finer clay.
cues.zh: 在那里他们把这些大块捣碎成更细腻的粘土。

cues.en: The women are drawing water to be mixed with the clay from the village's main well over 30 meters deep.
cues.zh: 妇女们正在村里深达30多业主井里打水，准备和粘土混合。

cues.en: The well was dug in line with concrete with the help of an American Peace Corps volunteer more than thirty five years ago.
cues.zh: 三十多年前，在一位美国和平队志愿者的帮助下，这口井被浇筑了混凝土并加固。

cues.en: The water is quite clean and safe to drink.
cues.zh: 这水相当干净，饮用安全。

cues.en: The elders are breaking the clay into fine pieces so it will absorb water evenly.
cues.zh: 长老们正把粘土砸成细块，以便它能均匀地吸收水分。

cues.en: Two deep pits are dug and the clay is mixed with water so that the liquid is absorbed or slaked into the clay uniformly.
cues.zh: 人们挖了两个深坑，将粘土与水混合，使水分均匀地被粘土吸收。

cues.en: This is a large bundle of the special fine straw from the wilderness that would be broken up to mix with the clay.
cues.zh: 这是一大捆从荒野中采集的特殊细稻草，之后会将它打碎，掺入黏土中。

cues.en: The 15 to 17 year old girls help out by bringing water.
cues.zh: 15 到 17 岁的女孩们负责帮忙运水。

cues.en: You can do it.
cues.zh: 你可以做到的。

cues.en: They wet the clay over there and then put it in this pit here.
cues.zh: 她们先在那边把黏土浇湿，然后放进这里的坑里。

cues.en: They gather it by hand and put it in the pit.
cues.zh: 她们用手把黏土收集起来，放进坑里。

cues.en: They fill the pit up completely.
cues.zh: 她们把坑完全填满。

cues.en: If it is not left to soak long enough, there will be little chunks that are not wet.
cues.zh: 如果浸泡的时间不够长，就会有一些小块没有被浸湿。

cues.en: They use Sonongo straw, so there will be no cracks in the walls.
cues.zh: 她们使用 Sonongo 稻草，这样墙壁就不会开裂。

cues.en: They use the same water to clean their hands,
cues.zh: 她们还用同样的水洗手，

cues.en: lots of water all over.
cues.zh: 到处都是水。

cues.en: They mix the clay and water in the pits and let it soak overnight.
cues.zh: 她们在坑里混合黏土和水，让它浸泡一整夜。

cues.en: A cap of fine straw is placed over the clay while it soaks to keep the hot sun off.
cues.zh: 浸泡时，她们会在黏土上盖一层细稻草，避免烈日直晒。

cues.en: They leave the fine straw on top to keep the bright hot sun off the moist clay so it won't dry out.
cues.zh: 她们把细稻草留在上面，挡住强烈的阳光，防止湿黏土变干。

cues.en: The
cues.zh: 第二天，

cues.en: next day, when all of the water is absorbed,
cues.zh: 等所有的水都被吸收后，

cues.en: the straw is kneaded into the clay.
cues.zh: 再把稻草揉进黏土里。

cues.en: Large amounts of fine straw are used. During
cues.zh: 这里会用到大量细稻草。在

cues.en: the heating, the straw turns to carbon,
cues.zh: 加热过程中，稻草会转化为碳，

cues.en: leaving fine voids, which allow the clay to expand and contract without cracking with changes of temperature.
cues.zh: 留下细小的孔隙，让黏土在温度变化时能够膨胀和收缩，而不会开裂。

cues.en: Jacob remarks in the video that the straw makes the clay stronger, which is true,
cues.zh: Jacob 在视频中提到，稻草能让黏土更坚固，这确实没错，

cues.en: but because it gives the walls of the furnace flexibility
cues.zh: 但更重要的是，它能让炉壁在

cues.en: when exposed to extreme heat.
cues.zh: 承受极端高温时保持一定的柔韧性。

cues.en: The process you are about to watch is the construction of the cylindrical furnace, the tubes or and
cues.zh: 接下来你将看到的是圆柱形熔炉、炉管和

cues.en: the bellows, which are then assembled for the smelting.
cues.zh: 风箱的建造过程，之后它们会被组装起来，用于冶炼。

cues.en: These
cues.zh: These

cues.en: are millet stalks around which the furnace will be formed.
cues.zh: 这些是小米秆，炉子将围绕它们建造。

cues.en: What
cues.zh: What

cues.en: are you making there?
cues.zh: 你在做什么？

cues.en: We're stripping bark to bind the stalks.
cues.zh: 我们在剥树皮来绑这些秆子。

cues.en: What would you like to do there? We're
cues.zh: 你想在那里做什么？我们

cues.en: going to build the tall furnace.
cues.zh: 要建那座高炉。

cues.en: First, we put down fine straw.
cues.zh: 首先，我们铺上细稻草。

cues.en: Then we put the millet stalks on top and take a few off so it's not too thick around.
cues.zh: 然后把小米秆放在上面，再拿掉几根，这样周围就不会太厚。

cues.en: It is all bound up into a cylinder the same dimensions as the inside of the furnace.
cues.zh: 它被全部捆成一个圆柱体，尺寸和炉子内部一样。

cues.en: Traditionally, this is how they're tied.
cues.zh: 传统上，他们就是这样绑的。

cues.en: They pick it up and tap it against the ground, so the ends will all be even.
cues.zh: 他们把它拿起来往地上敲，这样两端就会齐平。

cues.en: The wet clay from the termite mounds is needed with copious amounts of fine straw.
cues.zh: 白蚁丘的湿黏土需要加入大量细稻草。

cues.en: It is kneaded with straw to make it stronger.
cues.zh: 它和稻草一起揉捏，使其更结实。

cues.en: Uh-huh. It came.
cues.zh: 嗯哼。来了。

cues.en: Now they are ready to begin to build.
cues.zh: 现在他们准备开始建造了。

cues.en: This is the building of the tall furnace.
cues.zh: 这就是高炉的建造过程。

cues.en: The clay is applied around the straw mold to form the cylindrical furnace.
cues.zh: 黏土被涂在稻草模具周围，形成圆柱形炉子。

cues.en: Why are you putting that thing in there?
cues.zh: 你为什么把那个东西放进去？

cues.en: To open it up so the top is closer and formed to the bottom.
cues.zh: 为了把它撑开，让顶部更靠近，并与底部成形一致。

cues.en: It's going to expand the size of the top so the top will be the same size as the bottom.
cues.zh: 它会扩大顶部的尺寸，让顶部和底部一样大。

cues.en: We will smooth it out so it looks nice.
cues.zh: 我们会把它抹平，让它看起来好看。

cues.en: They add more straw so it won't break.
cues.zh: 他们加入更多稻草，这样它就不会裂开。

cues.en: When it is dry, they will pull out the stocks.
cues.zh: 等它干了，他们就会把秆子抽出来。

cues.en: They are kneading the clay with straw to make a clay body they can use to build the parts of the furnace.
cues.zh: 他们正在把黏土和稻草揉在一起，做出可用来建造炉子各部分的黏土体。

cues.en: Now they spread the clay over an overturned jar, so it will take the form of the jar.
cues.zh: 现在他们把黏土抹在一个倒扣的罐子上，让它形成罐子的形状。

cues.en: They add the claws around the edges so they will not dry out because they will continue the building afterward.
cues.zh: 他们在边缘加上爪状结构，防止干裂，因为之后还要继续搭建。

cues.en: They are using the clay straw mix to form
cues.zh: 他们用黏土和稻草的混合物来塑形

cues.en: forms the channel through which the air will flow.
cues.zh: 塑形成空气流经的通道。

cues.en: The French word for tubes is tuyeres,
cues.zh: 法语中管子的词是 tuyeres，

cues.en: which is the term that is used universally by archaeologists
cues.zh: 这是考古学家普遍使用的术语

cues.en: who find remains of these objects in archaeological sites
cues.zh: 他们在考古遗址中发现这些物体的遗存

cues.en: as evidence of smelting ages ago.
cues.zh: 作为很久以前冶炼活动的证据。

cues.en: I
cues.zh: 我

cues.en: think it is particularly important that all of this video was filmed by Jacob and Abdullah Bamigo.
cues.zh: 认为特别重要的是，这段视频全部由 Jacob 和 Abdullah Bamigo 拍摄。

cues.en: I was not even there, although I wish I had been.
cues.zh: 我甚至不在现场，虽然我希望自己在。

cues.en: This means that they alone have decided what is important and have filmed it, and they have decided what questions to ask.
cues.zh: 这意味着他们自己决定了什么重要并拍摄下来，也自己决定了要问什么问题。

cues.en: This gives the video a particularly African voice that I think is important.
cues.zh: 这赋予了视频一种特别的非洲声音，我认为这很重要。

cues.en: I hope that in years to come, the Bamagos and others in Burkina Faso will make more videos like this themselves.
cues.zh: 我希望未来几年，Bamago 一家和布基纳法索的其他人能自己制作更多这样的视频。

cues.en: These are small nozzles or funnels to direct the air into the kiln.
cues.zh: 这些是小型喷嘴或漏斗，用来把空气导入窑中。

cues.en: Sacrifices of millet water, beer, and chickens are offered to ask the spirits to watch over the enterprise
cues.zh: 人们献上小米水、啤酒和鸡作为祭品，祈求神灵看顾这项事业

cues.en: and to give the work success.
cues.zh: 并让工作顺利成功。

cues.en: The spirits are asked to drink the beer and eat the chicken,
cues.zh: 他们请神灵喝啤酒、吃鸡，

cues.en: and in return to bless the project.
cues.zh: 作为回报保佑这个项目。

cues.en: If you dislike seeing chickens getting their throats cut, please close your eyes and count to 20 slowly.
cues.zh: 如果你不愿看到鸡被割喉，请闭上眼睛慢慢数到20。

cues.en: I'm afraid a chicken was injured during the filming of this sequence.
cues.zh: 很抱歉，在拍摄这一段时有一只鸡受伤了。

cues.en: Yeah. It's good. It's good. Holding.
cues.zh: 好，很好。保持住。

cues.en: If the chicken dies on its back, the spirits accept the sacrifice.
cues.zh: 如果鸡仰面而死，就表示神灵接受了献祭。

cues.en: As you can see, Jacques Silva makes sure the chicken dies on its back.
cues.zh: 如你所见，Jacques Silva 确保鸡是仰面死去的。

cues.en: The claws are removed and what will be the base of the bellows is carefully turned right side up so the walls can be built higher and a rim added.
cues.zh: 爪子被去掉，然后作为风箱底座的部分被小心地翻转朝上，这样就能把炉壁建得更高，并加一圈边沿。

cues.en: The jar is removed from the inside.
cues.zh: 罐子从内部取出。

cues.en: The stalks and straw are carefully removed from inside the furnace.
cues.zh: 炉膛内的秸秆和稻草被小心地清除。

cues.en: Now two elders including Rasinga Bamago on the right, cut the opening through which the air will pass and the iron will emerge.
cues.zh: 现在，包括右侧的 Rasinga Bamago 在内的两位长者，开出空气进入和铁流出的开口。

cues.en: The opening is carefully shaped to fresh clay.
cues.zh: 开口用新黏土仔细塑形。

cues.en: This is a hole that permits God to see inside the furnace.
cues.zh: 这是一个让神能看到炉内的孔。

cues.en: They have now completed the furnace.
cues.zh: 他们现在完成了炉子。

cues.en: This is the completed furnace minus the bellows.
cues.zh: 这是完成后的炉子，不含风箱。

cues.en: Now it is time carefully to assemble the bellows, tuyeres and furnace.
cues.zh: 现在是时候小心地组装风箱、风嘴和炉子了。

cues.en: The kiln is assembled piece by piece.
cues.zh: 窑炉被一件件组装起来。

cues.en: The clay tubes or are
cues.zh: 黏土管

cues.en: pushed through holes in the bellows
cues.zh: 穿过风箱上的孔

cues.en: and fixed in place with fresh clay.
cues.zh: 并用新黏土固定到位。

cues.en: The bellows and tuyeres are attached to the furnace so that the air forced out of the bellows were... Will enter the base of the furnace.
cues.zh: 风箱和风嘴连接到炉子上，使风箱压出的空气……进入炉子底部。

cues.en: They have attached the tubes in the bellows.
cues.zh: 他们已经把管子装到风箱上了。

cues.en: These must dry for seven days before being moved.
cues.zh: 这些必须晾干七天才能移动。

cues.en: Jacques Sobe uses a flint and steel to light the inside of the furnace,
cues.zh: Jacques Sobe 用火石和钢点燃炉内，

cues.en: just as their ancestors did. This
cues.zh: 正如他们的祖先所做的那样。这

cues.en: will burn out the straw stubble inside the furnace and heat the furnace so it will dry completely.
cues.zh: 会烧掉炉内的秸秆茬，并加热炉子，使其完全干燥。

cues.en: To heat the inside of the furnace so it will dry.
cues.zh: 把炉子内部加热，让它干燥。

cues.en: That way, when the ore is burned tomorrow, it will be easy.
cues.zh: 这样明天烧矿石的时候就会容易些。

cues.en: As you can see, the Bamagos actually made two furnaces.
cues.zh: 如你所见，Bamagos实际上造了两座炉子。

cues.en: The first was fired successfully several days before the official smelting,
cues.zh: 第一座在正式冶炼前几天就成功点火了，

cues.en: so that they would be sure that they had gotten it right when the official guests arrived.
cues.zh: 这样他们就能确保正式宾客到来时一切无误。

cues.en: The last steps are to assemble the furnace and bellows.
cues.zh: 最后几步是组装炉子和风箱。

cues.en: Now that they have completed the furnace, they attach the tubes to the bellows, which will carry the air to the tall furnace.
cues.zh: 现在炉子已经完工，他们把管子接到风箱上，由管子把空气送到高炉里。

cues.en: Goatskins are tied to the top of each bellows in such a way that there is a flap or opening that opens up on the upstroke and closes on the downstroke, trapping the air and forcing it through the tubes.
cues.zh: 山羊皮绑在每个风箱顶部，做法是留出一个活瓣或开口，上推时打开、下压时关闭，从而兜住空气并迫使其通过管子。

cues.en: The elder Rasinga Bamago is a specialist in this step and personally supervises the attaching of the hides.
cues.zh: 年长的Rasinga Bamago是这一步的专家，亲自监督蒙皮的安装。

cues.en: You can see where the hide is folded on the left and right to form the valve through which the air enters the bellows.
cues.zh: 你可以看到皮子在左右两侧折叠起来，形成空气进入风箱的阀门。

cues.en: Strips of rubber inner tube are used to bind the hides in place.
cues.zh: 用橡胶内胎条把皮子固定到位。

cues.en: Jacquesoba helps Rozinga make adjustments.
cues.zh: Jacquesoba帮Rozinga做调整。

cues.en: He announces the furnace is ready to begin smelting the next day.
cues.zh: 他宣布炉子已准备好，第二天就可以开始冶炼。

cues.en: The climactic step in the process is the actual smelting.
cues.zh: 整个过程中最关键的环节就是实际冶炼。

cues.en: A senior elder pours alternating layers of charcoal and a mix of ore and flux into the top of the furnace.
cues.zh: 一位资深长老把木炭和矿石与熔剂的混合物交替分层倒入炉顶。

cues.en: The furnace is lit,
cues.zh: 炉子被点燃，

cues.en: and the young men of the village take turns pumping the bellows as hard as they can for hours on end.
cues.zh: 村里的年轻人轮流拼命鼓动风箱，一连几个小时不停。

cues.en: There is a great deal that can go wrong at this point after days of preparation.
cues.zh: 经过数天的准备，此时仍有很多环节可能出问题。

cues.en: The fire may not reach a temperature high enough to melt the ore,
cues.zh: 火焰的温度可能达不到熔化矿石所需的高度，

cues.en: or the furnace may crack, or worse, collapse, spreading sparks and incandescent slag and ore all over the area.
cues.zh: 或者炉子可能开裂，更糟的是坍塌，把火星、白热的炉渣和矿石溅得到处都是。

cues.en: Large numbers of people have gathered from local communities and from the capital, Ouagadougou,
cues.zh: 大量人群从当地社区和首都瓦加杜古聚集而来，

cues.en: which is about a 150 miles away.
cues.zh: 首都距离这里大约150英里。

cues.en: This is an important event.
cues.zh: 这是一件重要的大事。

cues.en: Burkinabis are curious about their cultural history,
cues.zh: 布基纳法索人对自己的文化历史充满好奇，

cues.en: and faculty and students from the University of Ouagadougou attend
cues.zh: 瓦加杜古大学的师生也前来参加，

cues.en: to see this reenactment of an important technology.
cues.zh: 观看这项重要技术的重现。

cues.en: These are bowls of zumkum,
cues.zh: 这些是一碗碗的zumkum，

cues.en: or millet water with sugar, that the young men will drink as they work at the bellows.
cues.zh: 也就是加糖的小米水，年轻人操作风箱时会喝。

cues.en: An elder offers some as sacrifices to the spirits by splashing it on the furnace.
cues.zh: 一位长者把一些洒在炉子上，作为对神灵的祭品。

cues.en: And Mosi Flautist plays a praise song associated with smithing.
cues.zh: Mosi Flautist吹奏一首与锻造相关的赞歌。

cues.en: You hear the Moray word repeatedly.
cues.zh: 你会反复听到Moray这个词。

cues.en: This is the word for iron furnace.
cues.zh: 这是铁炉的意思。

cues.en: One of the few senior elders who still has the strength takes a turn at the bellows.
cues.zh: 一位尚有余力的资深长者轮流操作风箱。

cues.en: You can hear that the university students are speaking French, not Moray,
cues.zh: 你能听出大学生们说的是法语，不是Moray语，

cues.en: because some of them are not Mosi and don't understand Moray.
cues.zh: 因为他们中有些人不是Mosi人，听不懂Moray语。

cues.en: This is the point where the air from the bellows enters the furnace.
cues.zh: 这里是风箱的空气进入炉子的地方。

cues.en: All of the smith elders and senior people from the community
cues.zh: 所有铁匠长者和社区里的资深人士

cues.en: are wearing their best clothes when they attend the smelting.
cues.zh: 参加冶炼时都穿着他们最好的衣服。

cues.en: At this point most of their work is done, and it's now up to the strong young men at the bellows to bring final success to the project.
cues.zh: 此时他们的工作大部分已完成，现在就靠拉风箱的壮小伙们为项目带来最终的成功。

cues.en: The
cues.zh: 那个

cues.en: elder in purple is the chief of Dablo.
cues.zh: 穿紫衣的长者是达布洛的首领。

cues.en: He and other chiefs wear the very distinctive hats that are unique in all of Africa to Mosi chiefs.
cues.zh: 他和其他首领戴着极具特色的帽子，这种帽子在整个非洲只有莫西族首领才有。

cues.en: There is ample evidence that chiefs have been wearing these hats since at least the sixteenth century.
cues.zh: 有充分证据表明，首领们至少从十六世纪起就一直戴着这种帽子。

cues.en: It is quite evident how hard these men are working as they pump the bellows.
cues.zh: 从他们鼓动风箱的劲头可以明显看出这些人有多卖力。

cues.en: Much patience is needed as an elder inspects the furnace through a small opening at the base to see if, based on the color of the flame, the temperature is right.
cues.zh: 一位长者透过炉底的小孔查看炉内，根据火焰颜色判断温度是否合适，这需要极大的耐心。

cues.en: The young men pump and pump and then pump some more.
cues.zh: 年轻人一鼓再鼓，鼓个不停。

cues.en: They eat from a bowl of millet water and sugar, very high in carbohydrates,
cues.zh: 他们吃的是小米水加糖，碳水化合物含量很高，

cues.en: and pump some more. They
cues.zh: 然后再鼓一阵。他们

cues.en: wait as more ore flux mix or more charcoal are added and pump some more.
cues.zh: 等着加入更多矿石熔剂混合物或更多木炭，然后再鼓一阵。

cues.en: Musicians play their flutes
cues.zh: 乐手们吹起笛子

cues.en: and praise songs about the strength and ability of the smith are sung and they pump some more.
cues.zh: 唱起赞美铁匠力量和技艺的颂歌，他们再鼓一阵。

cues.en: He reenergizes himself with Zumcombe.
cues.zh: 他靠Zumcombe补充体力。

cues.en: The first traces of liquid slag appear at the base of the furnace.
cues.zh: 炉底开始出现液态炉渣的痕迹。

cues.en: Flames emerge from the very base of the furnace.
cues.zh: 火焰从炉子最底部冒出来。

cues.en: The very bright liquid that looks like lava from Kilauea Volcano is in fact slag, not iron.
cues.zh: 那看起来像基拉韦厄火山熔岩的明亮液体其实是炉渣，不是铁。

cues.en: The iron never gets quite hot enough to flow this freely.
cues.zh: 铁的温度始终达不到能这样自由流动的程度。

cues.en: A big audience of students, elders, men and women, children, police and government officials
cues.zh: 大批观众——学生、长者、男女老少、孩子、警察和政府官员

cues.en: are drawn by an event they feel is very important. Many of the students are archaeology students who often find broken tree airs, slag, and bits of furnace in the sites they excavate.
cues.zh: 都被这场他们觉得非常重要的活动吸引而来。许多学生是考古专业的学生，他们经常在发掘的遗址中发现破碎的树形耳饰、炉渣和炉子碎片。

cues.en: This smelting helps them understand
cues.zh: 这种冶炼帮他们理解

cues.en: the process that created those artifacts.
cues.zh: 创造出那些器物的工艺过程。

cues.en: Heat and poisonous fumes pour from the hole through which God watches the inside of the furnace.
cues.zh: 热量和有毒烟气从洞口喷涌而出，上帝正是透过这个洞口注视着炉内。

cues.en: There's a pause while more charcoal and ore are added to the kiln.
cues.zh: 停顿片刻，往窑炉里加入更多木炭和矿石。

cues.en: Late in the afternoon, after ten hours of pumping,
cues.zh: 傍晚时分，经过十个小时的鼓风，

cues.en: a solid lump or bloom of iron has formed at the bottom of the furnace,
cues.zh: 炉底已经形成了一块固体的铁块，也就是铁坯，

cues.en: where the heat is almost white hot.
cues.zh: 那里温度高得几乎白热化。

cues.en: The end is in sight.
cues.zh: 终点就在眼前了。

cues.en: A large lump of slag is shoved aside.
cues.zh: 一大块炉渣被推到一边。

cues.en: The furnace breathes like a dragon as it gives up a throbbing mass of slag and iron.
cues.zh: 炉子像巨龙般喘息着，吐出一团跳动的渣铁混合物。

cues.en: The front of the furnace is broken off to reveal the large bloom of iron, weighing almost 30 pounds nestled among the glowing charcoal.
cues.zh: 炉子前壁被敲开，露出 nestled 在灼热木炭中的大铁坯，重近30磅。

cues.en: The mass of new iron is dull gray on the outside
cues.zh: 这块新铁外表呈暗灰色，

cues.en: and incandescent red on the inside.
cues.zh: 内部则是炽热的红色。

cues.en: It is rough because it has never completely liquefied,
cues.zh: 它表面粗糙，因为它从未完全液化，

cues.en: but in the heat of the furnace, it has fallen to the bottom of the furnace through the charcoal and slag where it has formed a large single mass.
cues.zh: 但在炉内高温下，它穿过木炭和炉渣沉到炉底，在那里聚成了一整块。

cues.en: The audience shows their appreciation and perhaps relief
cues.zh: 观众们表示赞赏，或许还有如释重负

cues.en: that it has turned out well.
cues.zh: 因为结果很成功。

cues.en: While the lump of new iron is still hot and soft, the elders drag it from the furnace and cut it into slabs with a wedge and hammer.
cues.zh: 趁着这块新铁还热乎柔软，长者们把它从炉中拖出，用楔子和锤子切成板状。

cues.en: The smiths then forge it into the shape of a useful tool or weapon in their sacred forge,
cues.zh: 然后铁匠们在他们的圣炉中把它锻造成实用工具或武器的形状，

cues.en: heating the iron red hot, then pounding it with traditional round hammers,
cues.zh: 把铁烧到红热，再用传统的圆锤敲打，

cues.en: heating again, hammering, heating and hammering.
cues.zh: 再加热，锤打，加热，锤打。

cues.en: Near the end, the shape is broadened in the wings that the smiths bend over to form the socket.
cues.zh: 最后，两端被锻宽，铁匠俯身将其弯成銎口。

cues.en: And finally, the edge is hammered as sharp as possible before the hoe blade is attached to the carved wooden handle.
cues.zh: 最后，刃口被尽可能锤薄，然后将锄刃装到雕削好的木柄上。

cues.en: Here the iron bloom is being cut into slabs with a wedge.
cues.zh: 这里，铁块正用楔子被切成板坯。

cues.en: The slabs will be forged into iron hose.
cues.zh: 这些板坯将被锻造成铁管。

cues.en: As usual, Jacques Sobobamago is right in the midst of the action.
cues.zh: 和往常一样，Jacques Sobobamago 正处在活动的中心。

cues.en: Now the smiths carry the chunk of iron to the forge,
cues.zh: 现在铁匠们把这块铁搬到锻炉旁，

cues.en: where it is again heated to yellow hot.
cues.zh: 在那里再次加热到黄热状态。

cues.en: The bellows are similar but smaller than the large bellows used in smelting.
cues.zh: 风箱与冶炼用的大风箱类似，但更小一些。

cues.en: The surround for the forge is an old steel rim from a large truck.
cues.zh: 锻炉的围圈是用一辆大卡车上的旧钢圈做的。

cues.en: This is the forge where they will make a hoe following the smelting of the iron.
cues.zh: 这就是他们在炼铁之后制作锄头的锻炉。

cues.en: Two senior smiths pull the hot iron from the fire and begin to shape it on the anvil.
cues.zh: 两位资深铁匠把烧红的铁从火中取出，开始在铁砧上塑形。

cues.en: Their round hammers are very old fashioned and traditional.
cues.zh: 他们的圆锤非常老式且传统。

cues.en: Contemporary smiths more often use hammers made in China.
cues.zh: 当代铁匠更多使用中国制造的锤子。

cues.en: This is called pumping iron.
cues.zh: 这叫“举铁”。

cues.en: One smith holds the iron on the anvil with tongs while they both hammer it into shape.
cues.zh: 一位铁匠用钳子把铁固定在铁砧上，两人一起锤打成型。

cues.en: When the iron is no longer soft enough, it is reheated.
cues.zh: 当铁不再足够柔软时，就重新加热。

cues.en: First the raw iron is formed into a flat rectangle.
cues.zh: 首先把生铁锻成扁平的矩形。

cues.en: Then each end is flared to form the blade and the socket.
cues.zh: 然后两端被展宽，形成刃口和銎口。

cues.en: This very strong vigorous pounding flares one end to form the socket.
cues.zh: 这非常有力而猛烈的锤打使一端展宽，形成銎口。

cues.en: The iron will be rested on these two hammers,
cues.zh: 铁将被搁在这两把锤子上，

cues.en: as the socket is shaped.
cues.zh: 以便塑造銎口。

cues.en: Now the smiths bend the socket around the handle of a hammer to give it a good uniform shape.
cues.zh: 现在铁匠把套筒弯成锤柄的形状，使其均匀成型。

cues.en: Now they thin and flare the blade of the hoe, and begin to form an edge.
cues.zh: 接着他们把锄刃打薄、向外展开，开始加工刃口。

cues.en: Another smith is carving the handle.
cues.zh: 另一位铁匠正在雕刻手柄。

cues.en: Smiths are usually the carvers of wooden masks and other sacred objects in African communities because they have responsibility of carving handles for the tools they make.
cues.zh: 在非洲社区里，木制面具和其他神圣物品通常由铁匠来雕刻，因为他们负责为自己制作的工具雕刻手柄。

cues.en: The final shaping of the edge of the hoe.
cues.zh: 锄刃的最后成型。

cues.en: The handle is tried for the first time.
cues.zh: 第一次试装手柄。

cues.en: The hot iron burns into the wood,
cues.zh: 炽热的铁烫入木头，

cues.en: shaping it to fit tightly.
cues.zh: 使其成型以便紧密贴合。

cues.en: The blade is cooled in water.
cues.zh: 刀刃在水中冷却。

cues.en: Now the hoe is finished.
cues.zh: 现在锄头完成了。

cues.en: Late in the afternoon, after the iron has been smelted
cues.zh: 傍晚时分，铁已经冶炼完毕，

cues.en: and the tools have been forged,
cues.zh: 工具也已经锻造完成，

cues.en: a community of Dablo and the invited guests celebrate
cues.zh: 达布洛的社区和受邀宾客一起庆祝

cues.en: the successfully completed project.
cues.zh: 这个项目圆满完成。

cues.en: The chief of Dablo presents a completed hoe to the representative of the minister of culture.
cues.zh: 达布洛的酋长向文化部长的代表赠送一把做好的锄头。

cues.en: Who
cues.zh: 他

cues.en: has taken on so many responsibilities over the past weeks
cues.zh: 在过去几周里承担了许多职责，

cues.en: presents a completed hoe to professor Kientiga.
cues.zh: 向基恩蒂加教授赠送一把做好的锄头。

cues.en: To close the ceremonies, the famous Mosi Warama dancers performed for the honored guests.
cues.zh: 仪式最后，著名的莫西·瓦拉马舞者为贵宾表演。

cues.en: It is interesting that their clappers and bangles are made of iron.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，他们的拍板和手镯都是铁制的。

cues.en: A musician blows a trumpet made of antelope horn.
cues.zh: 一位乐手吹响用羚羊角制成的号角。

cues.en: Finally, the last of the guests shake hands and greet each other and depart for Ouagadougou.
cues.zh: 最后，最后一批宾客互相握手致意，随后启程前往瓦加杜古。
